bugs_found_and_fixed.title: Rating panel visible on every page load
bugs_found_and_fixed.cause: .killi-rate-panel set display:flex unconditionally, beating the browser's [hidden] rule.

bugs_found_and_fixed.title: Mobile swipe-to-reveal record cards didn't actually swipe
bugs_found_and_fixed.cause: .admin-swipe-actions used inset:0, stretching it to the full card width, so the JS-measured reveal distance was ~4x too large.
bugs_found_and_fixed.fix: Changed to top/bottom/right only (no left), so it sizes to its own button content.

bugs_found_and_fixed.title: Result-detail modal resized on every tab switch
bugs_found_and_fixed.cause: .killi-modal was one scroll container around header+tabs+all tab-sections, so its box height matched whichever tab was visible.
bugs_found_and_fixed.fix: Fixed-height flex column; only a new .killi-modal-body wrapper scrolls, header/tabs stay pinned.

deferred_or_rejected.note: Full handoff spec written in KILLI_BUILD_STATUS.md; scoped rephrase-only, Ultra-gated, never free generation.
Killi's replies are template-driven, not generated — no free text for a sentiment model to steer. Existing rating/zero-result data is a cheaper signal.
